1170-1177-5078-8346.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Narset by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to look at the top four cards of your library, then reveal Sensei's Divining Top and put it into your hand.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Narset.
Repeat.

5078-5741-8176.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

856-5477-5776-6495.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Insidious Roots trigger.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
856-5477-5776-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1482-2866-4986-6495.description:
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
1482-2866-4986-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2866-3200-3899-4986.description:
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Urza's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

483-1981-2415-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing it to become a Spirit artifact creature in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat.

348-1152-4314-4867-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-1152-4314-4867-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Cormela from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Cormela and any creature not part of the combo.
When Cormela dies, it and Pawn of Ulamog triggers.
Resolve the Cormela trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

2034-5220-5632-6961-7824.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-5220-5632-6961-7824.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Chalk Outline triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

1169-1563-2457-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

2033-4785-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
2033-4785-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
2033-4785-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

1274-1545-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-1545-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-5477-5660-7296-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the tapped Plant, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

147-5256-7446.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-5256-7446.description:
Cast Moment of Reckoning by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Moment of Reckoning.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Moment of Reckoning
Resolve the Moment of Reckoning copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-5256-7446.notes: You can choose as many modes as allowed with Moment of Reckoning. You must choose the second mode once, but the other three can be as desired.

333-2511-7424.notablePrerequisites: Changing Loyalty attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-2511-7424.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1232-1270-5477-7175.description:
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate the Saprolings by tapping them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

1012-2511-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
1012-2511-4871-5220.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

2762-4659-6441.description:
Activate Thopter Squadron's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Thopter, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Thopter Squadron's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Thopter, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2060-4770-5998-6930.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

2060-2510-4518-6930.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2060-2510-4518-6930.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

2232-2792-6798-6843.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
2232-2792-6798-6843.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
Cast Anti-Venom by paying {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
When Anti-Venom enters, its first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Anti-Venom trigger, returning Great Whale from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Great Whale enters, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Anti-Venom from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Great Whale.
Repeat.

1409-2034-3895-4055.description:
Activate Diregraf Horde by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Diregraf Horde enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Diregraf Horde.
Resolve the Diregraf Horde trigger, creating two 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Zombies, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Energy Refractor by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Repeat.

4094-5658-6245-6753.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have the city's blessing or control at least six permanents.
4094-5658-6245-6753.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Declare Satya as an attacker. Satya triggers, creating four token copies of Ocelot Pride that are tapped and attacking and causing you to get {E}{E}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, the Ocelot Pride token gives you the city's blessing.
At the beginning of your end step, Satya triggers four times, and each Ocelot Pride you control triggers once.
Resolve the first Ocelot Pride trigger, causing you to create three 1/1 Cat creature tokens if you gained life this turn, and then causing you to create three token copies of each creature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn, and then causing you to create a token copy of each noncreature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Repeat step 5 for each remaining trigger.
4094-5658-6245-6753.notes: You may repeat this loop during subsequent turns to get even more creature tokens and ETB triggers.

915-4002-5856.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
915-4002-5856.description:
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate a Food using Synod Artificer's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping the Food and Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Repeat.

uses.n: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar

2034-2091-4558-4863.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least nine tapped lands.
2034-2091-4558-4863.description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Extus triggers, returning Revolutionist from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Mana Geyser, adding {R} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Cast Revolutionist by paying its mana cost.
When Revolutionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Geyser from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Revolutionist, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

413-650-710.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Danitha trigger, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2018-3532-4659-5078.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature that does not have flying.
2018-3532-4659-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library from the battlefield.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a creature without flying, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing the flying counter from the creature sacrificed in step 2.
Repeat.

2499-3487-4374.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two energy counters.
2499-3487-4374.description:
Activate Aethergeode Miner by paying {E}{E}, blinking it.
When Aethergeode Miner enters the battlefield, Aetherstorm Roc triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Repeat.

2724-3194-3582-4050.description:
Activate Kaya the Inexorable's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, putting a ghostform counter on Wormfang Manta.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wormfang Manta, adding {U}.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability and its ghostform ability trigger.
Resolve the ghostform trigger, returning Wormfang Manta from your graveyard to your hand and creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger due to Hushwing Gryff.
Repeat each turn.

2836-4322.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is greater than the number of cards in your library rounded up to the nearest multiple of seven.
2836-4322.description:
Activate Griselbrand by paying 7 life, causing you to draw seven cards.
Repeat until you draw from an empty library, winning the game.

1082-2232-2766-4298.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Swamp and at least one Forest that enter the battlefield untapped.
You have at least seven creature cards in your graveyard.
You have at least one Swamp card and at least one Forest card that enter the battlefield untapped in your graveyard.
1082-2232-2766-4298.description:
Activate a Swamp and Forest by tapping them, adding {B}{G}.
Cast Molderhulk by paying {B}{G}.
When Molderhulk enters the battlefield, it, Dual Nature's first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Dual Nature trigger, creating a token copy of Molderhulk.
When the Molderhulk token enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the nontoken Molderhulk from the battlefield to your hand.
When the nontoken Molderhulk leaves the battlefield, Dual Nature's second ability triggers, exiling the token Molderhulk.
Resolve the token Molderhulk's trigger from step 6, returning a Swamp from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the Swamp enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning another Swamp from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the nontoken Molderhulk's trigger from step 4, returning a Forest from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the Forest enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning another Forest from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Borborygmos Enraged twice by discarding the Swamp and Forest, dealing 6 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1082-2232-2766-4693.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Swamp and at least one Forest that enter the battlefield untapped.
You have at least seven creature cards in your graveyard.
1082-2232-2766-4693.description:
Activate a Swamp and Forest by tapping them, adding {B}{G}.
Activate Overgrown Estate twice by sacrificing the Swamp and Forest, causing you to gain 6 life.
Cast Molderhulk by paying {B}{G}.
When Molderhulk enters the battlefield, it, Dual Nature's first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Dual Nature trigger, creating a token copy of Molderhulk.
When the Molderhulk token enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the nontoken Molderhulk from the battlefield to your hand.
When the nontoken Molderhulk leaves the battlefield, Dual Nature's second ability triggers, exiling the token Molderhulk.
Resolve the token Molderhulk's trigger from step 7, returning a Swamp from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the Swamp enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers; choose not to return anything to your hand.
Resolve the nontoken Molderhulk's trigger from step 4, returning a Forest from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the Forest enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers; choose not to return anything to your hand.
Repeat.

4740-4916.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Aetherflux Reservoir lifelink.
Your life total is at least 51.
Animate Artifact attached to Aetherflux Reservoir.
4740-4916.description:
Give Aetherflux Reservoir lifelink, if needed.
Activate Aetherflux Reservoir by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to any target and causing you to gain 50 life.
Repeat step 2.

1322-3172-4499.notablePrerequisites: Forests and green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}.
1322-3172-4499.description:
Activate all Forests and all mana-producing green creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Patron of the Orochi by tapping it, untapping all Forests and all green creatures.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Patron of the Orochi.
Repeat.
If Forests and/or green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {4}, this combo nets infinite mana.

2474-3059-5253.notablePrerequisites: Brion does not have summoning sickness.
2474-3059-5253.description:
Activate Brion by paying {R}, tapping it and sacrificing Malignus, dealing damage equal to three times Malignus's power to target opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

386-1972-5280.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U} if each opponent has three or more poison counters, or {6}{U}{U}{U} otherwise
386-1972-5280.description:
Cast Echo of Eons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing each player to discard their hands and draw seven cards.
Nekusar triggers for each card your opponents draw.
Resolve the first trigger, causing the opponent to get a poison counter.
If the opponent has ten or more poison counters, they lose the game as a state-based action.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining trigger.
If needed, cast Echo of Eons from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to discard their hands and draw seven cards.
Repeat from step 2.

772-3175-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Repeat.
